parameters.name: FirmwareId
parameters.description:
The over-the-air update upgrade package ID, which is the unique identity of the upgrade package.

The over-the-air update upgrade package ID is one of the parameters returned when you invoke [CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~) to create an upgrade package.

You can invoke [ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~) to view the ID from the response parameters.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
